argument: Increasing the injection ratio of oxidant to silane-derived species in the plasma phase drives the deposited SiO2 film toward ideal stoichiometry.
boundary: Evidence is limited to the simulated PECVD system and the range of ratios examined in the study; transfer to other reactor geometries or precursor chemistries is unestablished.
claim: Increasing the injection ratio of oxidant to silane-derived species in the plasma phase drives the deposited SiO2 film toward ideal stoichiometry.

falsifier: The relationship can be tested experimentally by systematically varying the O2/SiH4 flow ratio in a PECVD reactor and measuring the Si/O atomic ratio of the deposited film via XPS or RBS.
